lines.japanese: 「終わったー！」
lines.english: “Finished!”

lines.japanese: 「思ったより早く終わったな」
lines.english: “We finished sooner than I expected.”

lines.japanese: 「思ったより……」
lines.english: “Sooner than you expected...”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、もう終わり？　これ私が神速で表紙を仕上げたからだよ！　どうしよう、これもしかしたら放浪の有名画家の目に留まってグッドデザイン賞にノミネートされたら？」
lines.english: “What, we're done already!? That's because I finished the cover at godspeed! What if some famous wandering artist spots it and nominates us for a Good Design Award?”

lines.japanese: うん。つくづく本当に早く終わって良かったと思う。山科さんを見ていると。
lines.english: Yes. Watching Yamashina, I found myself profoundly grateful that we had finished early.

lines.japanese: 「あ、じゃあ終わった記念にこの原稿用紙使ってキャンプファイヤーやる？　みんなで聖火リレーやろうよ、各階を回って最後にファイヤーって！　そのあとみんなでふんどしになってわっしょいわっしょい――」
lines.english: Oh, then to celebrate, should we use the manuscript paper for a bonfire? We can do a sacred-flame relay around every floor and finish with fire! Then we'll all put on loincloths and heave-ho, heave-ho—

lines.japanese: うん。終わったからと言って油断はできないな。山科さんを見ていると。俺は渡来明日香に彼女の拘束を指示すると、原稿用紙を安全な場所まで避難させた。
lines.english: Yes. Watching Yamashina, I realized that finishing was no reason to lower my guard. I ordered Asuka Watarai to restrain her and evacuated the manuscript pages to safety.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあこれで終わりだよなァ、もう帰っていいか？」
lines.english: “So that's it, right? Can I go home now?”

lines.japanese: 「なあ渡来、なぜここにはモチベーションの高いやつと低いやつ、両極端なのしかいないんだ」
lines.english: “Watarai, why is everyone on this team at one extreme or the other? They're either overflowing with motivation or have none at all.”

lines.japanese: 「んー、班長の類友だよね」
lines.english: “Birds of a feather, Chief.”

lines.japanese: 「自分のことを棚にあげるな」
lines.english: “Don’t hide your own faults up on a shelf.”

lines.japanese: 「棚からぼたもちだよね」
lines.english: “Maybe a rice cake will fall off that shelf while we’re at it.”

lines.japanese: 「棚つながりなのは分かるが、語感だけでムリヤリ嫌味を返そうとするな」
lines.english: “Yes, both lines have a shelf. You can’t force a comeback out of one word.”

lines.japanese: 「ぼたもち美味いよなあ。ああ、なんか腹へってきた」
lines.english: “Those rice cakes are good, though. Damn, now I'm hungry.”

lines.japanese: 「あんたも拾うな。引っぱるようなネタじゃないんだよ」
lines.english: “Don't pick that up too. The joke was never meant to keep going.”

lines.japanese: 「なあ明日香、なんか食べにいかねえか？」
lines.english: “Hey, Asuka. Want to get something to eat?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いいねえ。私もおなか空いてたんだ。一仕事終えたあとは甘いものが食べたくなるよね」
lines.english: “Oh, good idea. I'm hungry too. After finishing a job, you always want something sweet.”

lines.japanese: 「行くのは構わないが、まずはネタを消化してからだなあ……」
lines.english: “Go if you like, but first we ought to finish digesting the joke...”

lines.japanese: 「あ、はいはーい！　いくいく、私も行くー！　もーさっきからチョーおなぺこはらへりでおなかと背中がくっつくぞ！　ねえねえ行こうよ渡来さん、みんなで行けば腹十分目突破もヨユー！」
lines.english: “Me, me! I'm coming too! I'm super-hungrified, starving, tummy-stuck-to-my-back hungry! Come on, Watarai, let's go! If we all go, eating ourselves way past full'll be easy!”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ駅前でも行くかあ」
lines.english: “Then let's head toward the station.”

lines.japanese: 「意義なーし」
lines.english: “No objectiooons!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あれ？」
lines.english: “H-huh?”

lines.japanese: 次々に立ち上がる班員たちを尻目に、俺は一人拳を縦にして座ったままはてなマークを浮かべていた。
lines.english: As my teammates rose one after another, I remained seated alone, one fist held upright and a question mark floating over my head.

lines.japanese: 「ふっ、この俺を差しおいて出かけようとは、おまえらも偉くなったもんだ……」
lines.english: “Hmph. Trying to leave without me... You people have certainly gotten important.”

lines.japanese: 「なにが甘いものだ、そんなもの日本男児たる俺には必要ないのだ。浮かれやがって駄民どもが、おまえら全員虫歯菌に侵されてハイドロキシアパタイトを溶かされるがいいさ」
lines.english: “Sweet things? A Japanese man such as myself has no need of them. Celebrate while you can, worthless rabble. May cavity bacteria infest you all and dissolve your hydroxyapatite.”

lines.japanese: 「おーい、ぱね田っ！　なにしてんの、置いてくよー！」
lines.english: “Hey, Paneda! What're you doing? We're leaving without you!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、待って待って！」
lines.english: “Wait, wait!”

lines.japanese: へへ、とろとろしてたら前にも渡来に怒られたなあ。
lines.english: Heh heh. Watarai had scolded me for dawdling once before.

lines.japanese: 俺は慌てて鞄をつかむと、スキップで教室を飛びだした。
lines.english: I snatched up my bag and skipped out of the classroom.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあどこ行こっか」
lines.english: “So where should we go?”

lines.japanese: 「んー、がっつりいくか茶だけで済ますか……渡来的にはがっつり？」
lines.english: “Hmm. Do we eat a full meal, or settle for tea...? Watarai, are you hungry enough for a real meal?”

lines.japanese: 「お腹三分目くらいの気分かな。おいしいコーヒーが飲みたい」
lines.english: “I could eat maybe a third of a meal. Mostly I want a good cup of coffee.”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ！　渡来さん、お腹三分目なんてなに言ってんのワケ分かんないし略してアンビリ！　今日はがっつりいくべきでしょなに日和ってんの、んもー今日がっつりいかないでいつ食べるの」
lines.english: “What? A third of a meal? That makes zero sense, Watarai—unbeli, for short! Today we go all out! Why are you wimping out? If we don’t eat big now, when will we?”

lines.japanese: 「お茶も出来てがっつりもいけるところだね」
lines.english: “Somewhere we can have tea or eat a full meal, then.”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、中々難しい選択だよな。チェーン系のしゃらくさいおされカフェにはサンドイッチはあっても、がっつりメニューはないし……かと言ってファミレスはうるさいしな」
lines.english: “Hmm. That's a difficult combination. Those obnoxiously trendy chain cafés might have sandwiches, but nothing substantial... Then again, chain diners are noisy.”

lines.japanese: こんなカンジでさっきからだらだらと一時間。いい加減日も沈みかけてきた。
lines.english: We had been drifting along like this for an hour. The sun was finally beginning to set.

lines.japanese: 「おいさっきから非協力的なメガネ。あんたはなにか意見ないか」
lines.english: “Hey, uncooperative four-eyes. You got any ideas?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、俺？　だったらそこの店なんていいんじゃない」
lines.english: “Me? How about that place?”

lines.japanese: げっ。
lines.english: Ghk.

lines.japanese: そういえばここは花水木通りじゃないか。すっかり失念してた。
lines.english: Oh, hell. This was Dogwood Street. I had completely forgotten.

lines.japanese: Ｓランクの要注意人物を二人も連れてアルバイト先に入るなんて、全裸で虎穴に飛びこむようなもんだ。なんとか場所を変えなければ。
lines.english: Walking into my workplace with two rank-S high-risk subjects would be like leaping naked into a tiger's den. I had to steer them somewhere else.

lines.japanese: 「洋食レストラン……ふむふむ、コーヒーも美味しそうだしここいいかもね」
lines.english: “A Western restaurant... Hmm. The coffee looks good. This might work.”

lines.japanese: 「オムドリアフェアもやってるよ！」
lines.english: “They're having an omelet-rice gratin fair!”

lines.japanese: 「居心地も良さそうだしなあ。ファミレスにいそうなキャバスケとかいなそうだろ」
lines.english: “Looks comfortable too. Probably won't have any hostess-club chicks like you'd find at a family diner.”

lines.japanese: 「オムドリアフェアもやってるよ！」
lines.english: “They're having an omelet-rice gratin fair!”

lines.japanese: 「ま、待て、言い忘れてたが、俺はコーヒーと洋食とスパゲティが大の苦手で……」
lines.english: “W-wait. I forgot to mention that I can't stand coffee, Western food, or spaghetti...”

lines.japanese: 「えーなに、ぱね田くんは協調性ないなあ。こういうときは多少嫌いなものがあってもみんなに合わせなよ」
lines.english: “What? Paneda has no team spirit. Times like this, you go along with everybody even if there's a thing or two you don't like.”

lines.japanese: 「いるよなァ、選択肢が少ないってのに自分の好みを口にするやつ」
lines.english: “There's always one, isn't there? Hardly any choices to begin with, and they still insist on announcing their preferences.”

lines.japanese: 「お、おまえに言われたくないっ」
lines.english: “I-I don't want to hear that from you!”

lines.japanese: 「カレーライスにスープもつくよ！」
lines.english: “The curry rice comes with soup!”
“Wait...”

lines.japanese: しかし俺の制止も聞かず、三人は店へと入っていった。
lines.english: Ignoring my attempts to stop them, all three went inside.

lines.japanese: 「いらっしゃいま……」
lines.english: “Welco—”

lines.japanese: 「渡来先輩！？」
lines.english: “Watarai!?”

lines.japanese: 「あれ、玉泉？」
lines.english: “Huh? Tamaizumi?”

lines.japanese: 「どしたのどしたの渡来さん！　この美人ちゃんと知り合い？　それとも仇敵？　ここで沈めとく？」
lines.english: “What is it, Watarai? You know this pretty girl? Or is she your mortal enemy? Should we dispose of her right here?”

lines.japanese: 「ほほう、玉泉がこんなところでアルバイトしてるなんて知らなかった。どうして言ってくれなかったんだい、臭いじゃないか玉泉」
lines.english: “Well, well. I had no idea you worked here, Tamaizumi. Why didn’t you tell me? You smell, Tamaizumi.”

lines.japanese: 「あの、一文字抜けてます」
lines.english: “Um. I think you left ‘fishy’ out of that sentence.”

lines.japanese: 玉泉がなみなみと水の注がれたコップを渡来の前に差しだした。
lines.english: Tamaizumi placed a glass filled to the brim with water in front of Watarai.

lines.japanese: 「玉泉が働いてることを知ってたらお水の一つでも注文して一時間居座ってあげたのに」
lines.english: “If I'd known you worked here, I could've ordered a glass of water and occupied a table for an hour.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、だから言わなかったんです」
lines.english: “Yes. That's why I didn't tell you.”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　なんで玉泉の制服だけ他のひとと違うの？　もっと露出しなよ、足とか胸とか恥ずかしい部分をさ」
lines.english: “Hm? Why is your uniform different from everybody else's? Show more skin. Your legs, your chest—all the embarrassing parts.”

lines.japanese: 「渡来先輩のようなひとがいるからです」
lines.english: “Because people like you exist.”

lines.japanese: 「たまひよー、なにお客さんの案内もせずに待たせて……あ、知り合い？」
lines.english: “Tama-chick, why're you keeping customers waiting instead of seating—oh, friends of yours?”

lines.japanese: 「初めまして、玉泉さんと同じ学校の渡来といいます」
lines.english: “How do you do? My name is Watarai. I attend the same school as Tamaizumi.”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、どもー。たまひよ、だったらしばらく話してなよ。どーせお客さんも少ないし」
lines.english: “Oh, hello. Tama-chick, why don't you talk with them for a while? We're slow anyway.”

lines.japanese: 「気を使っていただいてすみません、お邪魔します」
lines.english: “Thank you, that's very kind. We'll try not to be a bother.”

lines.japanese: 「きもっ」
lines.english: “Creepy.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあなんて返せばいいか言ってみろ、おお？」
lines.english: “Then tell me what the hell I was supposed to say, huh?”

lines.japanese: 渡来がハリュー・クロードの脇腹に小突きを入れてる隙に、俺はそそくさと階段を駆けあがって事務室へと飛びこんだ。
lines.english: While Watarai jabbed Claude in the ribs, I scurried upstairs and darted into the office.

lines.japanese: 「ん？　なんだ鷲介、おまえ今日は休みじゃなかったのか」
lines.english: “Hm? What is it, Shusuke? I thought you had the day off.”

lines.japanese: 「いやあ、あんまり長いこと休んでるのも悪いなと思いまして」
lines.english: “Well, I felt bad about taking so much time away.”

lines.japanese: 「そうか……ところでおまえなんて格好してるんだ。それは美空学園の男子制服だろう」
lines.english: “I see... By the way, what are you wearing? That's the boys' uniform from Misora Academy.”

lines.japanese: 「コスプレです」
lines.english: “Cosplay.”

lines.japanese: 「ああなんだ、コスプレかあ」
lines.english: “Oh, cosplay. I see.”

lines.japanese: 上司がコスプレ好きだったおかげで、ややこしい説明をせずに更衣室に入ることが出来た。よかったよかった。
lines.english: Thanks to my supervisor's fondness for costumes, I reached the changing room without any complicated explanations. Good, good.

lines.japanese: 「おい、おまえらに言っておくことがある」
lines.english: “Listen. There's something I need to tell you.”

lines.japanese: 俺はゆっくり着替えを済ませると、三人の級友たちのもとへ向かった。彼らのテーブルの上には、初めに注文したと思われる飲み物と食事が届いていた。
lines.english: I changed at my leisure, then returned to my three classmates. The first round of drinks and food they had ordered was already on the table.

lines.japanese: 「わっ。えっ、それこの店の制服？　あのさぱね田くん、そういう悪戯は笑えないよ」
lines.english: “Whoa. Wait, is that this restaurant's uniform? Paneda, that kind of prank isn't funny.”

lines.japanese: 「違うよく聞け、俺はこの店の正式な従業員なのだ」
lines.english: “No. Listen carefully. I am a duly employed member of this establishment.”

lines.japanese: 「従業員？　アルバイトしてるってこと？」
lines.english: “An employee? You work here?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだ。だがさっき見た通り、この店にはうちの学校の生徒がもう一人いる。俺は校内での接触を避けるために美空学園の生徒だということをここでは隠している」
lines.english: “Right. But as you just saw, another student from our school works here. I hide the fact that I attend Misora Academy so I can avoid contact with her on campus.”

lines.japanese: 「でえ？　回りくどいことせずになにが言いたいかはっきりしなよ」
lines.english: “And? Quit taking the scenic route and say what you want.”

lines.japanese: 「お願いですから美空学園の生徒ってことは内緒にしてください」
lines.english: “Please, I'm begging you. Keep it secret that I attend Misora Academy.”

lines.japanese: 「エスプレッソ」
lines.english: “Espresso.”

lines.japanese: 「私、アイスティー！」
lines.english: “I’ll have iced tea!”

lines.japanese: 「俺、北京ダック」
lines.english: “Peking duck.”

lines.japanese: 「ぐぐっ、こいつら好き勝手しやがって……マスター、４番さんエスプレッソとアイスティー！　あと中華料理屋に出前お願いします！」
lines.english: “Grrr. Ordering whatever the hell you please... Boss! Table four wants an espresso and iced tea! And call a Chinese restaurant for delivery!”

lines.japanese: 「了解だ」
lines.english: “Understood.”

lines.japanese: ふう、とはいえこれでなんとかごまかせたか。ここのトコ休みがちだったから、これでマスターにも顔向けできるしな。
lines.english: Whew. Maybe I had managed to distract them. I had been missing work lately, and this would let me face the boss with a clear conscience too.

lines.japanese: よし、今日一日は真面目に従業員しよう。そうと決まれば燃えてきたぞ。
lines.english: Good. I would be a diligent employee for the rest of the day. Now that I had decided, I was getting fired up.

lines.japanese: 「さあどこかに手ごろなお客さんはいないかな？」
lines.english: Now, where can I find a nice easy customer to serve?

lines.japanese: 「おーい、千歳くーん！」
lines.english: “Hey, Chitose!”

lines.japanese: 「おっ、こんなときにうってつけの人材が！　どうも紀奈子さんこんにちは！」
lines.english: “Ah, the perfect candidate at the perfect moment! Good afternoon, Kinako!”

lines.japanese: 「ちわー。元気かい？　今週になって見かけないから心配してたんだよ」
lines.english: “Hey there. Doing okay? I hadn't seen you all week, so I was worried.”

lines.japanese: 「シュウちゃんは元気だよ。ねえ？」
lines.english: “Shu is fine. Right?”

lines.japanese: 「あれっ、カケルくんも来てたんだ。やあいらっしゃい」
lines.english: “Oh, Kakeru, you're here too. Welcome.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、浪人に会えるのもあと三ヶ月でしょ。今のうちに顔見とこうと思って」
lines.english: “Yeah. Only three months left before Retaker goes away, right? Thought I'd look at his face while I still can.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、鳳君引っ越すの？」
lines.english: “What? Are you moving, Ohtori?”

lines.japanese: 「浪人、苺農家継ぐんでしょ？　来年から浪人に代わる呼び方考えなきゃね。ああそうだ、農民でいいか」
lines.english: “Retaker, you're taking over the strawberry farm, right? I'll need a replacement nickname next year. Oh, I know. Peasant.”

lines.japanese: 「鳳君元気でね。遠くに行っても私のこと忘れないでね」
lines.english: “Take care, Ohtori. Don't forget me when you move far away.”

lines.japanese: 俺が来るまでこのひとたちはどういう会話をしてたんだろう。あまり考えたくなかった。
lines.english: What kind of conversation had these people been having before I arrived? I preferred not to think about it.

lines.japanese: 「そういえば、千歳君さっきあそこのお客さんと話してなかった？」
lines.english: “Come to think of it, Chitose, weren't you talking to those customers over there?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ、友達なんですよ、ははは」
lines.english: “Oh, yes. They're friends of mine. Ha ha ha.”

lines.japanese: 「トモダチ……へえ、友達ねえ」
lines.english: “Friends... Huh. Friends, you say.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、こっち見て……あれ、一人近づいてきた」
lines.english: “Oh, they're looking over here... Wait, one's coming.”

lines.japanese: はあ、ただでさえめんどくさいのにさらに厄介の種が……俺は万一に備えてお客さんのいないテーブルを端に寄せておいた。
lines.english: Sigh. As if the situation weren't troublesome enough, here came another source of disaster. As a precaution, I pushed an unoccupied table off to one side.

lines.japanese: 「どうもコケコケうるさいと思ったら、こんなところでニワトリを放し飼いにしてるとは驚いた店だねェ。耳障りだから外にオン出してくれないかな従業員さん」
lines.english: “I wondered what all that clucking was. What a remarkable restaurant, letting a Chicken roam loose indoors. The noise hurts my ears. Employee, would you toss him outside?”

lines.japanese: 「俺に振るな」
lines.english: “Don't make me part of this.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ？　ああ、なんか近づいてくるなとは思ってたけど、黒すぎて顔が分からなかったわー。あはは、食事中なんだから汚い面見せんなよ。ねえ従業員さん、視覚的公害だからカラスの頭に袋被せてくんない？」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh, I saw something coming, but it was too black to make out the face. Ahaha. I'm trying to eat, so keep that filthy mug away. Hey, employee, would you put a bag over Crow's head? He's visual pollution.”

lines.japanese: 「俺を巻きこむな」
lines.english: “Don't drag me into this.”

lines.japanese: 「わあ、鳳君とも友達だったんだ、凄い偶然だね」
lines.english: “Wow, you're friends with Ohtori too. What a coincidence.”

lines.japanese: 「せっかくですがァ、お友達扱いなんてはは、恐れ多い。お山の大将にはお山のプライドがあるでしょうからねェ」
lines.english: “With all due respect, calling myself his friend would be presumptuous. Even the king of his little hill has his pride.”

lines.japanese: 「浪人、こいつの言語理解できるんだあ、スゲェスゲェ。カラス語なんてカタコトしか分からないや」
lines.english: “Retaker, you can understand this guy's language? Wow, amazing. I only speak broken Crow.”

lines.japanese: 「ふふ、とっても仲が良さそうだね」
lines.english: “Hee hee. You two seem very close.”

lines.japanese: 「俺に同意を求めないでください」
lines.english: “Please don't ask me to agree with that.”

lines.japanese: 「で、何しに来たの？　お友達とお茶してんならこっち来んなよ。ああ、それともくっついてきたけどハブられてっから寂しくて構ってもらいに来たんだ？」
lines.english: “So what'd you come over for? If you're having tea with your friends, stay over there. Or did you tag along, get left out, and come begging for attention because you're lonely?”

lines.japanese: 「フッ、普段からガキ引きつれてるくせに一人でお食事とは、あんたも人望ないんだねェ。裸の王様があんまりにもお気の毒だから、しばらくお相手してあげましょうか、ファッキンニワトリ」
lines.english: “Hmph. You usually drag a pack of children around, yet here you are dining alone. You don't inspire much devotion either. Since His Naked Majesty looks so pitiful, perhaps I'll keep him company for a while. Fucking Chicken.”

lines.japanese: 「ねえ、これって『暇だから構ってよ』『やったあこっちも暇だったんだ』ってこと？」
lines.english: “So does that mean, 'I'm bored, play with me,' and, 'Yay, I was bored too'?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、まあ」
lines.english: “Yes, more or less.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、さすがは二人とも鳳君のお友達だね」
lines.english: “Ahaha. No wonder both of you are Ohtori's friends.”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ、二人ともの中に俺入ってんすか！　まだなにも言ってませんけど！」
lines.english: “What!? I'm one of the two now? I haven't even said anything!”

lines.japanese: 「カケルぅ、パスタセットお待たせぇ～ん」
lines.english: “Kakeru, your pasta set is reaaady.”

lines.japanese: 「ってあれ、お友達？　へえカッコいいじゃん、モデル仲間？」
lines.english: “Oh, are these friends? Wow, he's handsome. Another model?”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、ヒノエリ、脳に腫瘍でも出来たんじゃねえの？　いい病院知ってるけど中身ごと入れ替えてもらえば？」
lines.english: “Ahaha. Hinoeri, did a tumor grow in your brain? I know a good hospital. Ask them to replace the contents while they're at it.”

lines.japanese: 「フッ、だとしたらおまえのツラが良く見えてることが異常事態になるねえ。もう少し考えてからものを言いなよ」
lines.english: “Hmph. If that were true, seeing your face as handsome would be the real medical emergency. Think before you speak.”

lines.japanese: 「はっ！　同じだ！　カケルと同じ匂いがする！　やぁ～ん、このひと紹介してよカケルぅ」
lines.english: “Gasp! They're the same! He has exactly the same vibe as Kakeru! Oh, Kakeru, introduce me!”

lines.japanese: 「やだ」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: 「紀奈子さん見て、カケルがやきもち妬いてる」
lines.english: “Kinako, look. Kakeru's jealous.”

lines.japanese: 「ホントだ、えりちゃん愛されてるねー」
lines.english: “He really is. Eri, you're so loved.”

lines.japanese: 「はぁん、ニワトリさんはここでの弄られ役ですかげらげらげら。ああ店員さん、フライドチキンちょうだい」
lines.english: “Aha. So Chicken is the designated punching bag here. Ha ha ha! Oh, employee? Bring me fried chicken.”

lines.japanese: 「あれあれ、運動不足で腹出てきてんのに、そんな油っこいの食べていいの？　そっかカラスは雑食だから生ゴミでも食べるもんなあ。あっはっは」
lines.english: “My, my. Your belly's starting to stick out from lack of exercise. Should you really eat anything that greasy? Oh, right. Crows are omnivores. They'll eat garbage. Ahaha!”

lines.japanese: あ、ダメだこいつら。もう相手するのやめよう。
lines.english: Nope. These guys were hopeless. I was done dealing with them.

lines.japanese: 「おーい、４番さんの注文出来たぞー」
lines.english: “Hey! Table four's order is ready!”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、今いきまーす」
lines.english: “Coming!”

lines.japanese: マスターのお呼びがかかったので、これ幸いと危険区域から脱出することにした。
lines.english: The boss called for me, giving me the perfect excuse to escape the danger zone.

lines.japanese: 「はい、エスプレッソお待ちどう」
lines.english: “Here's your espresso. Sorry for the wait.”

lines.japanese: 「あのさ、ぱね田くんもこっちに加わってくれないかなあ」
lines.english: “Paneda, couldn't you come join us over here?”

lines.japanese: 「見て分かるだろう、仕事中だ」
lines.english: “You can see for yourself. I'm working.”

lines.japanese: 「みんなで打ち上げに来てるのに仕事始めるのって協調性ないよね」
lines.english: “We all came to celebrate together, and then you started working. That's not very cooperative.”

lines.japanese: 「うるさい、俺は仕事場に来るとウェイターとして体が疼いて仕方ないんだよ。文句ならみんなで打ち上げに来てるのに他の友達のところへ行ったあの男に言え」
lines.english: “Quiet. The moment I enter my workplace, my body aches to serve. If you want to complain, complain to the man who came to celebrate with us and then wandered off to his other friends.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ私行ってくるー！」
lines.english: “Then I'll go over there!”

lines.japanese: 「待ちなさい、俺が悪かったからやめなさい。分かった、今いる面子の中で一番暇そうな俺の友達を紹介してあげるから」
lines.english: “Wait. I was wrong, so don't. Fine. I'll introduce you to whichever of my friends looks least busy.”

lines.japanese: 「はーい、お邪魔しまーす。宿木ゼミナール私立文系Ａクラス、望月紀奈子ですっ。よろしくねおともだち」
lines.english: “Hello! Sorry to intrude. I'm Kinako Mochizuki, private-university humanities track, Class A, at Yadorigi Prep. Pleased to meet you, new friends!”

lines.japanese: 「どもー。天神大学経済学科１年、日野英里子でーす。二人はたまひよとも友達だよね？　良かったらこれからも遊びに来てよ」
lines.english: “Hey there. Eriko Hino, first-year economics student at Tenjin University. You two are friends with Tama-chick too, right? Come visit again sometime.”

lines.japanese: さすがは接客業で慣れた二人、人見知りなんて言葉とは無縁だ。紹介するまでもなく勝手に打ち解けてくれた。
lines.english: As expected of two customer-service veterans, neither had ever heard of shyness. They became friendly without waiting for an introduction.

lines.japanese: 「やー、えりちゃん見てこの子！　かーわいいーい、やんやん、キミ、アイドルとか興味ない？　お姉さんと一緒にスターを目指してみない？」
lines.english: “Eri, look at this girl! So cuuute! Hey, you interested in becoming an idol? Want to chase stardom with your big sister?”

lines.japanese: 「えー、芸人は誉められちゃうとボケにくいんですよ？　でもありがとうございます」
lines.english: “Oh, comedians have trouble playing the fool after somebody praises them, you know? But thank you.”

lines.japanese: 「なーに言ってるんさー、これだけ大したもの持ってたら、失われつつある正統派の流れを取りもどすことが出来るってー。ねえうにうにとか好き？　今からカラオケ行って練習しない？」
lines.english: “What're you talking about? With what you've got, you could restore the vanishing line of orthodox idols! Do you like Uni-Uni? Want to go practice at karaoke right now?”

lines.japanese: 「こらこら紀奈子さん、がっつき過ぎだって。確かにそれだけのもの持ってるとは思うけどさ」
lines.english: “Easy, Kinako. You're coming on too strong. Though I admit she has plenty to work with.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、そんなことないです、私ヨゴレ担当ですもん」
lines.english: “Ahaha, hardly. I'm the one they use for the humiliating bits.”

lines.japanese: 「いいなー、ソラ学にはこんなかわいい子がいるんだねー。ひよちゃんといいレベル高いなあ。みんなでアイドル目指そうよう」
lines.english: “Lucky! Sora Academy has girls this cute. Between her and Hiyo, the standard's sky-high. Come on, let's all become idols.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、じゃあ私たまひよ呼んできますよ」
lines.english: “Then I'll go fetch Tama-chick.”

lines.japanese: 「はーい、はいはいはーい！　じゃあ私今から履歴書かきまーす！」
lines.english: “Me me me! I'll start writing my résumé right now!”

lines.japanese: 「んー、よしキミには、えーと……右から二番目あたりのポジションを任せよう」
lines.english: “Hmm. All right, you can have... let's say second from the right.”

lines.japanese: 「うわ、いかにも適当なポジションだ」
lines.english: “Wow. What a spectacularly arbitrary position.”

lines.japanese: 「やだ、三人組の右から二番目！？　それやりすぎだってもー！　でも私が中心になるのは仕方ないことだよねやんごとなき私だよね、でも私ダンスが苦手な感は否めないから渡来さんよろしくね！」
lines.english: “Second from the right in a trio? That’s the center! That’s too much! But I suppose a lady of my standing couldn’t help ending up in the middle. I can’t dance to save my life, though, so I’m counting on you, Watarai!”

lines.japanese: 「えっ！　私いつの間にメンバーに入った？」
lines.english: “What!? When did I become a member?”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、山科さんだっけ？　話が分かる子だね、よし今日から私と二人でマネージメントの星を目指そう！」
lines.english: “Ahaha. Yamashina, was it? You catch on fast. Starting today, you and I are shooting for stardom as managers!”

lines.japanese: 「任せてよもー！　私が渡来さんを担いで盛り上げるよ、ほらわっしょいわっしょい、渡来さんも一緒にわっしょいわっしょい！」
lines.english: “Leave it to me! I’ll hoist Watarai up and get the crowd going. Heave-ho, heave-ho! Come on, Watarai, join in! Heave-ho!”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、いつから私だけになった！？」
lines.english: “What!? When did I become the only idol?”

lines.japanese: 「京と紀奈子のマネージメントユニット『サンダース２』結成だね！」
lines.english: “The management unit Sanders Two—Miyako and Kinako—is born!”

lines.japanese: 「いやマネージャーにユニット名とかいらないでしょ」
lines.english: “Managers don't need a unit name.”

lines.japanese: 「それは違うぞ、今はなにが当たるか分からない時代だからな」
lines.english: “That's where you're wrong. These days, you never know what might catch on.”

lines.japanese: 「ええそうですね、うっかり当たっちゃってうっかり大スターなんてことがある世の中ですから……って、ええっ！？　アナタなにうっかり装って話に加わってきてんすか！」
lines.english: “Yes, true. One accidental hit and you might accidentally become a superstar... Wait, what!? Why are you pretending you just wandered into this conversation?”

lines.japanese: 「何を言う、先ほど望月君と日野君を彼女たちに紹介していたじゃないか。ならばこの狩男を紹介しない道理がどこにある。どうもお嬢さん方、私は軽部狩男、このアレキサンダーでマスターを勤めております」
lines.english: “What are you talking about? You just introduced Mochizuki and Hino to these young ladies. What possible reason could there be not to introduce Karuo as well? A pleasure, ladies. I am Karuo Karube, master of this establishment, Alexander.”

lines.japanese: 「マスター！？　なにマスターって、ご主人様とかそういうマスター？　それなら私ご主人様に仕えたら凄いよメイドさんとか女中とかもうなんでもやるよ」
lines.english: “Master!? What kind of master like a lord and master? Because if that's it I'd be amazing at serving you I'll be a maid or house servant or absolutely anything!”

lines.japanese: 「おおノリのいいお嬢さんだ、ならば俺をご主人様と呼んではくれないか」
lines.english: “What a spirited young lady. Then would you call me Master?”

lines.japanese: 「ご主人様！」
lines.english: “Master!”

lines.japanese: 「店長！　いま接客業にあるまじき表情になってます！」
lines.english: “Manager! That expression has no place in customer service!”

lines.japanese: 「す、すまん、俺は冷遇されていた時期が長かったので、このようなひとの温かさに触れられるとは思っていなかったのだ……望月君、彼女はキミの後継者になれる素材じゃないかね」
lines.english: “S-sorry. I endured a long period of cold treatment, so I never imagined I would feel such human warmth again... Mochizuki, might she have the makings of your successor?”

lines.japanese: 「こらこら、面白いって理由だけで従業員を採用しようとせんでください」
lines.english: “Come on. Don't hire people merely because you find them amusing.”

lines.japanese: 「ならばおまえは何故ここにいる」
lines.english: “Then why are you here?”

lines.japanese: 「いま明かされる衝撃の事実！」
lines.english: “A shocking truth comes to light!”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、なにを言ってるんだ。おまえには一発ギャグの期待こそすれ、他には何一つ一切がっさいこれっぽちも何かしてもらおうと思っていないぞ」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha. What are you talking about? I expect the occasional gag from you. Apart from that, I have never hoped you would do one single solitary thing.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、分かる分かる」
lines.english: “Oh, I know exactly what you mean.”

lines.japanese: 「うるさいしゃべるな、同調するな」
lines.english: “Quiet. Don't speak. Don't agree with him.”

lines.japanese: 「だが今回美女二人を連れてきてくれたことには感謝しているぞ。ああアルバイトを頼んでおいてよかった」
lines.english: “Still, I am grateful that employing you brought two beautiful women here today. Ah, hiring you was worthwhile after all.”

lines.japanese: 「私ここでアルバイトしようかな」
lines.english: “Maybe I should work here.”

lines.japanese: 「頼むからやめてくれ、おまえと狩男の組み合わせはそれだけで風俗営業法違反に等しい」
lines.english: “Please don't. You and Karuo together would practically violate the adult-entertainment laws by existing.”

lines.japanese: 「はい、悪い冗談はやめてください」
lines.english: “Yes. Enough of that terrible joke.”

lines.japanese: 「ただいまー、たまひよも連れてきたよ」
lines.english: “We're back! I brought Tama-chick too.”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、二人ともおかえりー。わーい、ひよちゃんも遊ぼうよ」
lines.english: “Welcome back! Yay, Hiyo, come play with us.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、遊びに来たわけじゃありません。手が空いたから様子を見に来たんです」
lines.english: “I-I didn't come to play. I had a free moment, so I came to see what was happening.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなこと言わずにお話しようよ。ねえねえ渡来さんの隣に座って。二人が並ぶと凄くいい絵になると思うんだあ」
lines.english: “Don't say that. Come talk with us. Sit beside Watarai. I think the two of you would make a wonderful picture together.”

lines.japanese: 「そうそう、マネージメントなら私たちサンダース２に任せていいよ！　私たちが二人を世界の舞台にまで押しあげてあげるからハリウッド女優ヨユー！」
lines.english: “Exactly! Leave the management to Sanders Two! We’ll take you both to the world stage. Hollywood stardom? Easy!”

lines.japanese: 「サンダース２ってなんすか？」
lines.english: “What’s Sanders Two?”

lines.japanese: 「私と山科さんのマネージメントユニットだよ」
lines.english: “The management unit formed by Yamashina and me.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあソレ私も入りますよ。歌って踊れるマネージャー目指しましょう」
lines.english: “Then I'm joining. Let's become managers who can sing and dance.”

lines.japanese: 「もうマネージャーでも何でもねえよ」
lines.english: “At this point, you're not even managers anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ねえねえそれなら結成の記念にみんなで写真撮ろーよ！　どーする決めポーズとか作る？　やだこの写真が伝説の幕開けになるかと思うと緊張してきたはいコレ写メよろしく！」
lines.english: “Ooh, let’s all take a picture to celebrate! Should we make up a signature pose? This could be the start of a legend—I’m getting nervous! Here, use my phone!”

lines.japanese: 「甘ったれるな」
lines.english: “Don't expect me to do everything for you.”

lines.japanese: 「こら、お客様のケータイを叩きおとすとは何事だ。これは業務命令だ、ちゃんと写真を撮って差しあげなさい」
lines.english: “Hey! You do not knock a customer's phone out of her hand. This is a work order: take the photograph properly.”

lines.japanese: 「ぐうっ、ぐ、ぐぐっ……」
lines.english: “Ghh... G-grrr...”

lines.japanese: 「あ、じゃあ私もよろしきゅー！」
lines.english: “Oh, then one with mine too, pleash!”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ私もお邪魔しよっかな。よっこいせっと」
lines.english: “Guess I’ll squeeze in too. Heave-ho.”

lines.japanese: 「ほらたまひよもメインなんだから真ん中に入れって」
lines.english: “Come on, Tama-chick. You're one of the stars, so get in the middle.”

lines.japanese: 「わ、私は関係ありませんよ。だってサンダース３の結成記念じゃないですか」
lines.english: “I-I have nothing to do with this. It’s commemorating the formation of Sanders Three, isn’t it?”

lines.japanese: 「玉泉君、これは業務命令だ。お客様と一緒に写って差しあげなさい」
lines.english: “Tamaizumi, this is a work order. Join the customers in the photograph.”

lines.japanese: 「ああもうっ、本当にこの店はっ！」
lines.english: “Oh, honestly! This restaurant!”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ撮りますよー、はいモッツァレラ！」
lines.english: “Taking it now. Say mozzarella!”

lines.japanese: 「いくよみんなたちーっ！　横ぴぃ――す☆」
lines.english: “All right, everybodies! Sideways peeeace☆”

lines.japanese: 「ＤＥＡ――ＴＨ★」
lines.english: “DEAAATH★”

lines.japanese: 「あれっ？　ちゃんとみんなピースした？」
lines.english: “Huh? Did everybody do the peace sign properly?”

lines.japanese: 「しませんよ、そんなの……」
lines.english: “Of course not...”

lines.japanese: 「こーら、たまひよー。年齢一番下のおまえがやってあげないと、最年長の紀奈子さんがかわいそうでしょ？」
lines.english: “Come on, Tama-chick. You're the youngest, so you have to humor Kinako, the oldest.”

lines.japanese: 「何でかわいそうなんだ？」
lines.english: “Why does that make me pitiable?”

lines.japanese: 「はいはい、さっさと次いくー。次４つめな」
lines.english: “Yes, yes, moving right along. Fourth phone next.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、それ私のケータイだ。みんな気合い入れてよろー」
lines.english: Oh, that's my phone. Everybody, give it your all, okay?

lines.japanese: 「はいゴルゴンゾーラ！」
lines.english: “Say gorgonzola!”

lines.japanese: 「ダブル横ぴぃ――す☆」
lines.english: “Double sideways peeeace☆”

lines.japanese: 「ＴＨＲＡＳＨ！！」
lines.english: “THRASH!!”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、どうして私がこんなこと……」
lines.english: “Sigh. Why am I doing this...?”

lines.japanese: 「よし、これで玉泉を除いて四人分のケータイで撮ったぞ……あ、あれ？　みんな見てくれ、何故かここにもう一つ携帯電話が！」
lines.english: “Good. That's four phones, excluding Tamaizumi's... H-huh? Everybody, look! For some reason, here's another phone!”

lines.japanese: 「あっれ、おかしいね。店長ですか？」
lines.english: “How strange. Is it the manager's?”

lines.japanese: 「いや自分で撮っているから、俺のケータイではないな」
lines.english: “No, I've been taking my own photographs. It isn't mine.”

lines.japanese: 「いいから早く済ませてください、使えない写真係ですね」
lines.english: “Just hurry up and finish. What a useless photographer.”

lines.japanese: 「マスター、誰のものか分からないから俺たちの記念写真でも残しておいてあげましょう」
lines.english: “Boss, since nobody knows whose it is, let's leave them a commemorative photograph of us.”

lines.japanese: 「うむ、もっともだ。じゃあいくぞ、はいバター犬！」
lines.english: “Quite right. Here we go. Say doggy style!”

lines.japanese: 「イェーイ」
lines.english: “Yaaay.”

lines.japanese: 「ファーック」
lines.english: “Fuuuck.”

lines.japanese: 「私のケータイを汚さないでくださいっ！」
lines.english: “Do not defile my phone!”

lines.japanese: 「なんだ玉泉のだったのか。それなら最初から言ってくれればよかったのに」
lines.english: “Oh, it was Tamaizumi's. You should've said so from the beginning.”

lines.japanese: 「はい、私のです。ですから早く済ませてください」
lines.english: “Yes, it is mine. So please finish quickly.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあいきますよー、こっち向いてはい、チーズ！」
lines.english: “Here we go. Look this way and say cheese!”

lines.japanese: 「って言ったら撮るんだよ」
lines.english: “I take it when I say cheese.”

lines.japanese: 「玉泉ー、女の子なんだから写真に写るときはもっとかわいい顔した方がいいよ」
lines.english: “Tamaizumi, you’re a girl. You should make a cuter face when you’re in a picture.”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、三方ヶ原の戦いで敗れた徳川家康は、そのときの悔しさを肖像画として残し、後の教訓にしたと言います。私もこの写真を見るたびに今日の怒りを思いだすことでしょう。ありがとうございました」
lines.english: “No. After Tokugawa Ieyasu's defeat at the Battle of Mikatagahara, he supposedly had his humiliation preserved in a portrait as a lesson for the future. Each time I see this photograph, I too shall remember today's fury. Thank you very much.”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん、確かに羅刹みたいな顔してるもんね。んじゃまた来るよ。バイバイ玉泉」
lines.english: “Hmm. You really do look like a wrathful demon. Well, I’ll stop by again. Bye, Tamaizumi.”

lines.japanese: 「また来るらしいぞ」
lines.english: “She says she'll be back.”

lines.japanese: 「知りません。千歳さんが相手をしてください」
lines.english: “I don't care. You can deal with her, Chitose.”

lines.japanese: その後閉店まで玉泉はこの調子だったので、俺は小さくなりながら作業を続けた。
lines.english: Tamaizumi remained like this until closing, so I kept working with my shoulders hunched, trying to make myself as small as possible.

lines.japanese: 帰り際に明日も頑張りますと告げたら、玉泉が能面のような笑顔で頑張ってくださいと激励してくれた。よし、明日も頑張るぞ。
lines.english: As I left, I told her I would work hard again tomorrow. With a smile as fixed as a theater mask, Tamaizumi encouraged me to do my best. Good. I would work hard tomorrow too.
